name: app.R
content:
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(readxl)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)


install.packages(c("shinylive", "httpuv", "readxl", "writexl"))


library(shinylive)

shinylive::export(".", "docs")

# Load the final dataset
excel_file <- "Dealer Sales Data.xlsx"
sheet_names <- excel_sheets(excel_file)
dealer_data <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = sheet_names[1])

# Clean column names for easier handling in R
names(dealer_data) <- c("Dealer_ID", "Dealer_Name", "City", "Region", 
                        "Quarterly_Sales", "Quarterly_Target", "Sales_vs_Target", 
                        "Old_Inventory", "DSO", "CSAT", "Market_Share", "Health_Index")

ui <- page_sidebar(
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, preset = "flatly"),
  title = "Automotive Dealer Health & Triage Engine",
  
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 320,
    h4("Triage Controls"),
    selectInput("region_filter", "Select Region:", 
                choices = c("All", unique(dealer_data$Region)), 
                selected = "All"),
    sliderInput("health_threshold", "Max Health Index Cutoff:", 
                min = 0, max = 100, value = 65, step = 5),
    hr(),
    h4("AI Assistant (ChatGPT)"),
    passwordInput("openai_key", "OpenAI API Key:", placeholder = "sk-..."),
    actionButton("ask_ai", "Generate AI Insights", class = "btn-primary w-100"),
    hr(),
    helpText("Select a distressed dealer in the table below to analyze their primary root cause.")
  ),
  
  layout_column_wrap(
    width = 1 / 3,
    value_box(
      title = "Monitored Dealers",
      value = textOutput("total_dealers"),
      theme = "primary"
    ),
    value_box(
      title = "Critical Intervention (<50)",
      value = textOutput("critical_count"),
      theme = "danger"
    ),
    value_box(
      title = "Operational Support (50-64)",
      value = textOutput("support_count"),
      theme = "warning"
    )
  ),
  
  layout_column_wrap(
    width = 1,
    card(
      card_header("🚨 Triage & Root Cause Diagnosis Table"),
      DTOutput("triage_table")
    )
  ),
  
  layout_column_wrap(
    width = 1,
    card(
      card_header("🤖 Executive AI Recommendations (ChatGPT API)"),
      verbatimTextOutput("ai_output")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reactive dataset with automated root cause diagnostics
  processed_data <- reactive({
    dealer_data %>%
      mutate(
        Priority_Tier = case_when(
          Health_Index < 50 ~ "🔴 Critical Intervention",
          Health_Index < 65 ~ "🟡 Operational Support",
          Health_Index < 80 ~ "🔵 Watchlist",
          TRUE ~ "🟢 Top Performer"
        ),
        Root_Cause_Diagnosis = case_when(
          Health_Index >= 80 ~ "None (Top Performer)",
          Old_Inventory > 30 & DSO > 50 ~ "Cash Flow Trap: High aged inventory & severe payment delays",
          Old_Inventory > 30 ~ "Yard Stagnation: Excess stock sitting >90 days",
          DSO > 50 ~ "Payment Default Risk: High Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)",
          CSAT < 3.0 ~ "Service Bottleneck: Poor customer satisfaction & complaints",
          Sales_vs_Target < 90 ~ "Quota Deficit: Missing quarterly sales targets",
          TRUE ~ "Multi-factor Operational Drag"
        )
      )
  })
  
  # Filtered dataset
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- processed_data()
    if (input$region_filter != "All") {
      df <- df %>% filter(Region == input$region_filter)
    }
    df <- df %>% filter(Health_Index <= input$health_threshold)
    df
  })
  
  output$total_dealers <- renderText({ nrow(processed_data()) })
  output$critical_count <- renderText({ 
    processed_data() %>% filter(Priority_Tier == "🔴 Critical Intervention") %>% nrow() 
  })
  output$support_count <- renderText({ 
    processed_data() %>% filter(Priority_Tier == "🟡 Operational Support") %>% nrow() 
  })
  
  output$triage_table <- renderDT({
    datatable(
      filtered_data() %>% select(Dealer_ID, Dealer_Name, City, Region, Health_Index, Priority_Tier, Root_Cause_Diagnosis, Quarterly_Sales),
      options = list(pageLength = 6, dom = 'ftp'),
      rownames = FALSE,
      selection = 'single',
      colnames = c("ID", "Dealer Name", "City", "Region", "Health Index", "Priority Tier", "Root Cause Diagnosis", "Quarterly Sales (INR)")
    ) %>% formatCurrency('Quarterly_Sales', currency = "₹ ", interval = 3, mark = ',')
  })
  
  # ChatGPT API Integration for Live Insights
  ai_insights <- eventReactive(input$ask_ai, {
    req(input$openai_key)
    
    selected_row <- input$triage_table_rows_selected
    df <- filtered_data()
    
    if (length(selected_row) == 0) {
      return("Please select a specific dealer row in the table above to generate targeted AI recommendations.")
    }
    
    dealer <- df[selected_row, ]
    
    prompt <- paste0(
      "Act as a senior strategy consultant for an automobile manufacturer. ",
      "Analyze this distressed dealer and provide a 3-step corrective action plan:\n",
      "Dealer Name: ", dealer$Dealer_Name, " (", dealer$City, ", ", dealer$Region, ")\n",
      "Health Index: ", dealer$Health_Index, "/100\n",
      "Priority Tier: ", dealer$Priority_Tier, "\n",
      "Root Cause: ", dealer$Root_Cause_Diagnosis, "\n",
      "Quarterly Sales: ₹", format(dealer$Quarterly_Sales, big.mark=","), " vs Target: ₹", format(dealer$Quarterly_Target, big.mark=","), "\n",
      "Old Inventory (>90 days): ", dealer$Old_Inventory, "%\n",
      "Payment Delay (DSO): ", dealer$DSO, " days\n",
      "CSAT Score: ", dealer$CSAT, "/5.0\n"
    )
    
    response <- POST(
      url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
      add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", input$openai_key)),
      content_type_json(),
      body = toJSON(list(
        model = "gpt-4o-mini",
        messages = list(list(role = "user", content = prompt)),
        temperature = 0.5
      ), auto_unbox = TRUE)
    )
    
    if (status_code(response) == 200) {
      res_content <- content(response, as = "parsed")
      return(res_content$choices$message$content)
    } else {
      return(paste("API Error:", status_code(response), "-", content(response, as = "text", encoding = "utf-8")))
    }
  })
  
  output$ai_output <- renderText({
    if (input$ask_ai == 0) {
      "Click 'Generate AI Insights' after typing your OpenAI API key and selecting a dealer from the table to view customized management advice."
    } else {
      ai_insights()
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
